offering_description.value: Provides fiber internet, voice telephone and video services to homes and businesses in rural and suburban areas of Virginia and nearby states. Delivers them over its own fiber network and local telephone infrastructure.

primary_products.value: broadband internet; voice telephone; video; business connectivity

primary_services.value: internet access; voice service; business network services

customer_segment.value: B2C: households in rural and suburban communities; B2B: small and midsize businesses and institutions

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly internet, phone and video plans; service fees: installation and equipment fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells connectivity to households and businesses over its own network; asset operator: owns and runs fiber and telephone network infrastructure

geography_served.value: US regional: Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, Pennsylvania and Tennessee

specialization.value: related lines: broadband internet, voice telephone, video and business network services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales staff and customer service teams; online: online ordering and account management

regulatory_exposure.value: high: telephone carrier licensing and oversight by the FCC and state public service commissions

notes: Service territory and product mix are from memory and may have changed; legacy video and wireless holdings may be outdated.
